messages:
alex: Morning team — quick decklet: drop a 1–2 line update: what you did yesterday / blockers / what you're on today. Keeping it short, moving async. I'll start:

alex: yesterday — wrapped up model-bundle rollout test for v2, validated perf on small seq lengths. blocked: intermittent perf variance on p95 in eu-west. today — triaging kernel selection telemetry and prepping a small canary.

jamal: yesterday — landed CR for cache eviction tuning. no blockers. today — will run load tests and then request a review @alex. small note: saw a repro of the p95 spike when batch size > 8.

sophia: yesterday — worked on CI flakiness; tracked failing test to race in kv cache init. blocker: need a small test harness to repro consistently.
sophia: quick repro command i used:
```bash
pytest tests/test_kvcache.py::test_prefetch -k fast -q
```
sophia: today — instrumenting init path and adding a repro job to CI. ping me if you want access to the sandbox.

lena: yesterday — docs PR for rollout playbook (runbook + rollback steps). blocker: need someone to sanity-check the rollback CLI snippet.
lena: today — hoping for a quick review from @mike or @alex so I can merge before EOD.

mike: yesterday — adjusted Dedicated autoscale policy thresholds, deployed config to staging. verified throughput curve looks smoother.
mike: today — will watch the canary and tweak burst settings if needed. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/scaling/1234 (staging).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment v2-canary -> staging finished in 3m 12s. health checks: 12/12 passing. :rocket:

jamal: acked, will run load tonight and attach the report. @sophia — i can help with the harness if you want.

alex: thanks all. no urgent blockers called out besides the kv race and p95 variance. small asks: 1) @sophia + @jamal pair on the harness, 2) @lena get one reviewer (mike/alex) for runbook, 3) mike watch canary.
alex: if anything turns high-priority ping #eng-oncall. otherwise i'll circle back with a short post-mortem if the p95 repro appears. :thumbsup:
